text: An analyst confirms that a Microsoft Entra risky user is genuinely compromised and selects Confirm user compromised. What does that action do to the risk record?

choices.text: Sets user risk to high and adds an admin-confirmed compromise detection
Immediately resets the password and closes every associated incident
Marks the user safe and removes the detections from future learning
Deletes the risky sign-ins while leaving the user risk unchanged

text: A sanctioned penetration test generates a real Microsoft Entra risk detection for a test account. The detection is valid, but the activity is known and nonmalicious. Which risk disposition best matches that finding?

A responder removes a confirmed phishing message from users' mailboxes with the Soft delete action in Threat Explorer. Where is the message moved so that it can still be recoverable subject to mailbox retention?

While reviewing a Defender XDR incident attack story, an analyst identifies a suspicious device and wants to investigate its broader activity without manually rebuilding a query from scratch. Which incident action is designed to pivot directly into relevant Advanced Hunting queries for that entity?

An incident contains an obfuscated PowerShell event in the attack story. The responder wants an AI-assisted explanation of the script and a mapping of behaviors in the script to ATT&CK techniques. Which embedded capability should be used?

A Defender for Cloud Apps alert points to an unusual cloud activity. The analyst wants to inspect exactly what event data the connected application sent rather than relying only on the normalized activity view. Which option in the activity drawer provides that evidence?

A rogue network device cannot run Defender for Endpoint, but it is communicating with several Defender-onboarded endpoints. The SOC wants those onboarded endpoints to block communications with the rogue device while investigation continues. Which response action best matches this objective?
A hunter needs both alert severity and the files, IP addresses, users, or devices associated with each alert. Which TWO Advanced Hunting tables should be correlated on AlertId?

A hunter is looking for a malicious executable that might have been created, renamed, or modified on Windows endpoints. Which Advanced Hunting table is the best starting point for those file-system events?

Persistence is suspected through modification of Windows registry run keys on several endpoints. Which Advanced Hunting table should a hunter query first for registry-entry creation and modification events?

A hunter wants a case-insensitive match for the whole indexed term powershell within a command-line column, rather than matching the same characters inside a larger word. Which KQL operator is the better fit?

A complex Advanced Hunting query parses a large JSON column and then applies a one-hour time filter. The query repeatedly approaches resource limits. Which change best follows Microsoft's query optimization guidance?

choices.text: Apply the time filter before parsing the JSON
Replace the time filter with an unscoped search
Parse every column before reducing the result set
Expand the query to union all available schema tables

text: A SOC wants email messages only when High-severity endpoint alerts affect devices in the production-server device group. Which configuration most directly provides that filtering?

choices.text: An alert email rule scoped to the production-server group and High severity
A Sentinel automation rule that assigns every incident to the server team
A Sentinel workbook filtered to the production-server device group
A Defender XDR Threat analytics notification rule filtered by report tags

text: An analyst wants email only when Microsoft publishes or updates Threat analytics reports tagged for ransomware, rather than notifications for every new security alert. What should be configured?

choices.text: An incident notification rule filtered to High severity
A Threat analytics notification rule filtered by report tag
An endpoint alert notification rule scoped to a device group
A Sentinel scheduled analytics rule that emails the analyst

text: A Defender for Endpoint device group uses Full - remediate threats automatically. Automated investigation determines that a file is malicious. What should an analyst expect?

choices.text: The remediation action waits for approval on the Action center Pending tab
Automatic remediation, with the result recorded in Action center History
The investigation records a verdict but never performs a remediation action
The device is automatically deleted from its Defender device group

text: A device group is configured as Semi - require approval for all folders. Automated investigation proposes remediation of a malicious file, but no analyst approves or rejects the action. What happens to the pending action?

choices.text: It is approved automatically after 24 hours
It times out after 7 days, which is treated as a rejection
It remains pending until the device is removed from the group
It is promoted to full automation after the next investigation

text: A workstation matches the membership rules for two Defender for Endpoint device groups. One group has rank 1 and the other has rank 3. Which group receives the device?

choices.text: Both groups, because matching groups are cumulative
The rank 3 group, because higher numbers have greater priority
The rank 1 group, because rank 1 has highest priority
Neither group until an administrator resolves the overlap manually

text: An organization enables Defender for Endpoint role-based access control. A user previously relied only on the Microsoft Entra Security Reader role for read-only portal access. What should the security administrator plan for?

choices.text: The user keeps identical access because Entra read-only roles bypass Defender RBAC
The user loses portal access until assigned through Defender RBAC
The user automatically receives the Defender for Endpoint Global Administrator role
The user can view all devices but loses only the ability to export reports
